attributes.action: Reversal of social media ban for under 16s to under 13s.
attributes.additional_details: This partition is about getting rid of the law about social media being banned for under 16 and changing it to under 13.
attributes.background: To revoke the law stating that in 2027 social media will be banned for all under sixteens in the UK and change it to all under thirteen.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

Government ban on social media to be for under 13s only
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/757849
